title: Amelia | Printed skirt with effortless flow
bodyHtml:
You'll love how this printed skirt lets you feel feminine and free at the same time. The fluid cut skips tight waistbands and clingy fabrics—just soft comfort that moves with you whether you're sitting, walking, or getting on with your day. Pair it with anything in your wardrobe and it falls beautifully, skimming rather than clinging, and the hidden pockets are a genuine bonus.

Why you'll love it

  • Printed design that adds colour and life to your everyday rotation
  • Relaxed, flowing silhouette that doesn't cling—pure comfort from morning to night
  • Sits kindly on your body without ever feeling restrictive
  • Elasticated waist that adjusts naturally to your shape for all-day wear
  • Deep side pockets that actually fit your essentials—and don't show a thing
  • Pairs effortlessly with everything from t-shirts to blouses
  • Perfect for warm days and everything in between

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
